Phase 2
interlocutor
Now, let’s talk about food.
Back-up prompts
A, what did you have for breakfast today? Did you have toast for breakfast today?
Where do you usually buy your food? Do you buy your food from a market?
B, do you like eating fast food? Do you like burgers and pizza?
How often do you cook? Do you cook every day?
extended response Back-up questions
Now, A, please tell me something about What is your favourite food?
your favourite dish. How often do you eat your favourite food?
Is your favourite food easy to make?
interlocutor
Now, let’s talk about weekends.
Back-up prompts
B, what do you usually Do you do your hobbies every weekend?
do at the weekend?
When did you get up last weekend? Did you get up late last weekend?
A, who do you spend your weekends with? Do you spend your weekends with your family?
What are you going to do next weekend? Are you going to a party next weekend?
extended response Back-up questions
Now, B, please tell me what you Did you meet your friends last weekend?
did last weekend. Where did you go last weekend?
Was it a good weekend?

A2 KeySpeaking Sample Test 1
© Cambridge University Press and UCLES 2019
Phase 1
interlocutor Now, in this part of the test you are going to talk together.
¸ 3–4 minutes Place Part 2 booklet, open at Task 2a, in front of candidates.
Here are some pictures that show different ways to travel.
Do you like these different ways to travel? Say why or why not. I’ll say
that again.
Do you like these different ways to travel? Say why or why not.
All right? Now, talk together.
Candidates ………………………………………………………..
¸ Allow a minimum of 1 minute (maximum of 2 minutes) before moving on to
the following questions.
interlocutor / Do you think …
Candidates … travelling by taxi is a good idea?
… riding a bike is fun?
… travelling by bus is popular?
… going on holiday by plane is difficult?
… travelling by train is exciting?
interlocutor So, A, which of these ways to travel do you like best?
And you, B, (which of these ways to travel do you like best)?
Thank you. (Can I have the booklet, please?) Retrieve Part 2 booklet.
Phase 2
interlocutor Now, is it important to learn to drive a car, B? (Why?)
And what about you, A? (Is it important to learn to drive a car?) (Why?)
Do you prefer visiting new places or places you know, A? (Why?)
And what about you, B? (Do you prefer visiting new places or places you know?)
(Why?)
Thank you. That is the end of the test.
Optional prompt
Why? / Why not?
What do you think?
Use as appropriate.
Ask each candidate
at least one question.
